description:
Carefull

Carefull is an AI-powered financial safety platform that helps banks, credit unions, and wealth advisors protect older adult customers from fraud and money mistakes. In doing this, we help financial institutions win whole family relationships while protecting their clients. Carefull's technology tackles senior-specific challenges to financial safety. Our financial monitoring identifies potential fraud patterns not picked up by industry-standard tools, because they do not have our expertise in understanding the unique exposures people face as they age. Our other features, including identity theft protection, password and document management, communication, and how-to content, are all created to help customers maintain financial independence and facilitate their loved ones stepping in to help.

The Role

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to own and evolve the analytics foundation that helps Carefull make better product and business decisions. You will build reliable data models and pipelines, partner directly with Go-to-Market and other teams, and turn ambiguous requests into actionable insights and scalable solutions. This is not a dashboard-only role: you will question assumptions, identify recurring needs, and make pragmatic decisions about what to build, automate, or decline.

How We Work

Ownership here means caring about the outcome, not only the delivery. We work in small, fast increments, because a focused change in front of users today teaches us more than a complete one next week. We're a small, flat data team. You'll own analytics and help with other data work when the team needs it.

You'll have a lot of autonomy in how you approach problems, and we trust people to find the next step on their own. When you're stuck, a quick question is always welcome, and short, frequent updates go a long way on a remote team.

We use AI coding tools heavily and expect you to as well. We also expect you to understand what you ship and to be able to explain the reasoning behind every change.

What You'll Do

  • Own and improve our analytics stack on AWS, including Redshift administration, dbt models, ETL/ELT pipelines, data quality, documentation, and monitoring.

  • Own our LLM observability platform: keep it healthy with support from our DevOps team, set the conventions for how the team traces LLM calls, and turn traces, costs, and evaluation scores into reporting the team can act on.

  • Translate open-ended questions from Go-to-Market, Customer Success, Product, and leadership into clear metrics, trustworthy analysis, and recommended actions.

  • Build reusable datasets and reporting foundations rather than repeatedly producing one-off analyses.

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows and improve reliability, performance, and cost.

  • Proactively investigate trends in activation, engagement, retention, partner performance, and product adoption; communicate what the business should do next.

  • Set clear metric definitions, challenge weak assumptions, and communicate caveats and data limitations.

  • Set up access rules and guardrails so teams and AI agents that connect to the warehouse get numbers they can trust.

  • Respond to pipeline incidents, diagnose root causes, and prevent recurrence.

  • Collaborate with teammates through reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

Who You Are

Required:

  • 3+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar data role.

  • Strong SQL and hands-on experience modeling analytical data in a warehouse.

  • Production experience with dbt and with building reliable ETL/ELT pipelines.

  • Working knowledge of Python and cloud-based data systems.

  • Track record of independently owning ambiguous, cross-functional projects from problem definition to measurable outcome.

  • Business judgment: you know when to analyze, automate, productize, simplify, or push back.

  • Ability to explain data limitations and recommendations clearly to nontechnical stakeholders in English.

  • Pragmatic approach to data quality, testing, observability, and maintainability.

Strong Plus:

  • AWS and Amazon Redshift experience.

  • Fintech, banking, B2B2C, or regulated-data experience.

  • Experimentation, product analytics, lifecycle/engagement metrics, and partner-facing analytics.

  • Experience with LLM observability or tracing tools, such as Langfuse.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools effectively and critically

Interview Process

  • Silver Screening interview

  • Client Screening interview

  • Take-home challenge

  • Take-home Defense

  • Product interview with US team

  • Final interview CEO (optional)
